sign_up_offers.terms:
SingSaver Exclusive Welcome Offer promotion is valid from 1 September 2026 to 31 December 2026.
Promotion is valid for New-to-DCS customers only.
Apply and get approved for the DCS Flex Visa Platinum Card and make the min. spend of S$800 within 30 days of card approval to be eligible for reward.
Rewards are fulfilled by DCS.
Promotion is stackable with other Welcome Offers from DCS where applicable (additional T&Cs apply).

 apply.

extra.description: Chasing your next holiday? Fast-track your flight redemptions with the DCS Flex Visa Platinum Card. Rack up up to 2.4 miles per dollar (mpd) on all your online shopping, daily contactless taps, and overseas holiday spend. If your travel plans change, no stress—toggle inside the app anytime to switch between Air Miles, up to 8% Cash Rebates, Investment Credits, or Carbon Offsets. Skip the rigid rules and earn miles on your own terms. Start flexing.
